dedupe_keys.name: 船木鉄道株式会社 gtfs transit data

description:
船木鉄道株式会社: GTFS transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by 船木鉄道株式会社. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Sanyo-Onoda, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. Coverage: Sanyo-Onoda, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed for this provider (Sanyo-Onoda, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Bike Allowed, Fares V1, Feed Information, Headsigns, Location Types, Shapes, Translations. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. Note in the listing: GTFSデータ公開終了のお知らせ

GTFSデータ作成ツールの規約変更に伴い、
令和8年3月31日をもちまして、GTFSデータの公開を終了いたします。

これまでご利用いただき、誠にありがとうございました。

今後の情報につきましては、弊社ホームページにてご案内いたしますので、
引き続きご確認くださいますようお願い申し It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence given by link only (https://developer.odpt.org/terms/data_basic_license.html). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
